identity: Chain for unaccompanied soprano saxophone by Michio Kitazume
findings: Zen-On confirms Sugawa's commission and premiere on 26 February 2010 at Tokyo Opera City Recital Hall in the Fukushi/Kitazume composer concert.
Publisher describes overlapping musical ideas forming a chain through time. Edition SEO-017 was released 15 April 2011; ISBN 9784115600171, ISMN M223322874.
CiNii records approximately 8 minutes 30 seconds. Suntory's work list gives 9 minutes and 2010.

evidence.claim: Solo soprano, commission, premiere and edition

evidence.source_name: Suntory Foundation for the Arts Japanese composers list

gaps: Exact recording not verified; do not confuse Kazunori Miyake's Chain for marimba with this work.
Publisher sample viewer exists but notation not successfully inspected; range and extended techniques remain unverified.
